verdict.rationale: Ardent is a hosted database-branching service, so choosing a storage region or residency is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never documents a way to pick a region or residency. The architecture doc says data stays in the data plane and only metadata reaches the control plane, but that describes data flow, not a user choice of storage location, so it is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
